def: to be a binder (captor), i.e. to enchain (a prisoner), to tie on (a load)

occurrences.text: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
